name: Auditory Comfort
description: Measures how comfortable the sound environment is, including noise levels, echoes, background conversations and sudden sounds.

name: Visual Comfort
description: Measures how comfortable the visual environment is, including lighting, brightness, glare, colours and visual distractions.

name: Legibility
description: Measures how easily users can understand and navigate the environment, including layout, signage, landmarks and route clarity.

name: Safety & Security
description: Measures how safe and secure users feel within the environment, including visibility, accessibility and confidence when using the space.

name: Predictable Space
description: Measures how consistent and predictable the environment is, including expected activity levels, routines, layout and possible changes.
